summary: Build reliable ETL pipelines with SQL, Python, dbt, and Airflow. Train your team to automate, validate, and monitor data workflows.
lede: Data engineering training teaches technical professionals to build and operate pipelines that move source data into analytical systems. Learners practice Python-based ingestion, SQL transformation, dbt modeling, and Apache Airflow orchestration to automate pipeline tasks. They also apply checks for freshness, completeness, uniqueness, and data drift, and explore monitoring and deployment workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technical professionals who need to build, automate, validate, and monitor data pipelines in real work settings.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of SQL joins, aggregations, and filtering, plus basic Python syntax for data handling. Familiarity with relational databases, CSV files, APIs, or cloud storage is helpful, and no advanced coding or production DevOps experience is required. A laptop with Docker Desktop installed is recommended for hands-on labs, and participants should be prepared to work with sample datasets, transformation scripts, and orchestration examples.
